entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production fantasy game construction-material resource icon. Clear chunky silhouette recognisable at 40px, rich but restrained painted detail, warm upper-left light, visible wood end grain. Centered square composition, the bundle occupies 85% of the square, all parts fully visible. Painterly fantasy game UI asset, not flat vector, not pixel art, not glossy plastic.
